description: This Java abstract class serves as a base controller for the web shop application. It provides utility methods for session management, exception handling, and pagination, and defines common behaviors for other controllers.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common web controller functionalities such as session management, exception handling, and pagination for subclasses.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute value by key from the HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute value for the specified key in the HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute identified by key from the HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Fetches the Language object from the request attributes, based on the Constants.LANGUAGE key.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during request processing, returning appropriate error views based on exception type.

methods.name: createPaginaionData
methods.description: Creates a PaginationData object initialized with page number and size.

methods.name: calculatePaginaionData
methods.description: Calculates total result count and updates the provided PaginationData object.
